sloka: प्रकृत्या कोपनं ह्येनं पुत्रस्य पुनराधयः।दीप्तं सन्दीपयामासुर्घर्मे ऽर्कमिव रश्मयः ।। ६.९३.१७ ।।
transliteration: prakṛtyā kopanaṁ hyenaṁ putrasya punarādhayaḥ।dīptaṁ sandīpayāmāsurgharme 'rkamiva raśmayaḥ ।। 6.93.17 ।।

translations.english: By nature, he is angry. Now with the loss of his son, he was glowing like the Sun that shines brighter by the rays in summer.
